It looks like a casing problem, using `<slot name="boolean" :hasBeenClicked="hasBeenClicked"></slot>
` works

rename.from: Slot props boolean not working as expected while object works fine
rename.to: kebab case props on slots are not transformed to camelcase

body: @posva I see. Actually very similar issue happens with `$emit()` – please see this [sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/vue-3-emit-event-names-ouovq?file=/src/App.vue) & open console. I suspect it will be fixed in same PR so I didn't open new issue.
There is already another issue opened about events casing I think
For posterity: `$emit` is fixed when you use latest `@vue/compiler-sfc` as described in https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/issues/2429

issue.title: fix(compiler-core): transform kebab case props to camelcase on slots (close #2488)
